name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.268.0 — A derived test now sweeps every /spec:<name> mention in shipped plugin text against the command files and skills on disk, so retiring a command no longer depends on a hand-written list of banned names; the last genesis-explore mention in the genesis driver is reworded. 7.267.0 — readers keep only the surviving escape fields — the owed query, the amendment join, the review-survivor match fields and the unclassed-rows scan retire from the fleet reader, status and doctor; release routes a defect to /spec:fix; canonical pipeline and review prose elide the retired names. 7.266.0 — The escape command is deleted: a fix commit touching lines a reviewed spec landed records the escape row itself through /git:commit step 3 (one row per commit, class the only question), the escape row loses six derived fields, a red CI observation surfaces as a /spec:fix entry, and the review driver's done-spec refusal names /spec:fix; hosts re-stamp with /spec:doctor.
